name: invideo
description: invideo lets agents generate videos from a script or a prompt in the signed-in invideo account. Each user signs in to their own invideo account through the browser.

prompts.text: Make a 60-second explainer video about how our app syncs files.
Turn this blog post into a short video with voiceover.
Create a 30-second vertical video that announces our spring sale.

apps.name: invideo
apps.description: Video generation from scripts and prompts, over invideo's MCP server with browser sign-in.
